4000000000.name: Doubtful Components
4000000000.description:
2 pieces : Every 3 enhancement rate, Atk + 2, Matk + 2.
4 pieces : Increases physical and magical damage against all size enemies by 1%, Atk + 10, Matk + 10.
4000000000.description_k:
2개 : 3강화 당, ATK + 2, MATK + 2씩 증가.
4개 : 모든 크기의 몬스터에게 주는 물리 / 마법 데미지 +1%, ATK + 10, MATK + 10.

4000000001.name: Demigod
4000000001.description:
2 pieces : Increases physical and magical damage against boss type monsters by 10%.
3 pieces : Increases physical and magical damage against boss type monsters by 15%, every 3 enhancement rate, increases physical and magical damage against boss type monsters by additional 3%.
4000000001.description_k:
2개 : 보스형 몬스터에게 주는 물리/마법 데미지 10% 증가.
3개 : 보스형 몬스터에게 주는 물리/마법 데미지 15% 증가, 3강화 당, 보스형 몬스터에게 주는 물리/마법 데미지 3%씩 추가 증가.

4000000002.name: Syncytium
4000000002.description:
2 pieces : S.Matk + 15,
increases damage taken from all property by 15%.
every 3 enhancement rate,
reduces damage taken from all property by 3%,
increases poison and ghost property magical damage by 4%.
4000000002.description_k:
2개 : S.Matk + 15, 
모든 속성 공격에 대한 내성 15% 감소.
3강화 당,
모든 속성 공격에 대한 내성 3%씩 증가,
독속성, 염속성 마법 데미지 4%씩 증가.

4000000003.name: Predator
4000000003.description:
2 pieces : P.ATK + 20, increases damage taken from all property by 15%, 
every 3 enhancement rate, reduces damage taken from all property by 2%, increases melee and long ranged physical damage by 4%.
4000000003.description_k:
2개 : P.ATK + 20,
모든 속성 공격에 대한 내성 15% 감소.
3강화 당,
모든 속성 공격에 대한 내성 2%씩 증가,
근접 및 원거리 물리 데미지 4%씩 증가.

4000000004.name: Frozen Horn
4000000004.description:
2 pieces : S.MATK + 20, every 3 enhancement rate, additional S.MATK + 4.
5 pieces : Increases poison, earth, wind and water property magical damage by 25%, every 3 enhancement rate, increases poison, earth, wind and water property magical damage by additional 3%.
4000000004.description_k:
2개 : S.MATK + 20. 3강화 당, S.MATK + 4씩 추가 증가.
5개 : 독, 지, 풍, 수속성 마법 데미지 25% 증가. 3강화 당, 독, 지, 풍, 수속성 마법 데미지 3%씩 추가 증가.

4000000005.name: Encroachment
4000000005.description:
2 pieces : Increases physical damage against boss type enemies by 20%, increases physical damage against normal type enemies by 5%, every enhancement rate,
increases physical damage against normal and boss type enemies by additional 1%.
4000000005.description_k: 2개 : 보스 등급 적에게 주는 물리 데미지 20% 증가, 일반 등급 적에게 주는 물리 데미지 5% 증가. 1강화 당, 일반 및 보스 등급 적에게 주는 물리 데미지 1%씩 추가 증가.

4000000006.name: Footsteps of Dimension
4000000006.description:
2 pieces : Increases physical / magical damage against monsters in Encroached Geffenia area by 10%, every 3 enhancement rate, increases physical / magical damage against monsters in Encroached Geffenia area by additional 3%.
3 pieces : POW + 10, SPL + 10, CON + 10, CRT + 10. P.ATK, S.MATK + 15.
5 pieces : MaxHP + 5%,  every 3 enhancement rate, additional MaxHP + 3%.
4000000006.description_k:
2개 : 잠식된 게페니아 지역에 등장하는 몬스터에게 주는 물리/마법 데미지 10% 증가. 3강화 당, 잠식된 게페니아 지역에 등장하는 몬스터에게 주는 물리/마법 데미지 3%씩 추가 증가.
3개 : POW + 10, SPL + 10, CON + 10, CRT + 10, P.ATK, S.MATK + 15.
5개 : MHP + 5%. 3강화 당, MHP + 3%씩 추가 증가.

4000000007.name: Working Group
4000000007.description: 2 pieces : MaxHP + 3%, every 5 enhancement rate, additional MaxHP + 5%.

4000000008.name: Company
4000000008.description:
2 pieces : Increases melee / long ranged physical damage by 6%, every 3 enhancement rate, increases long ranged physical damage by additional 1%.
4 pieces : P.ATK + 20, increases melee / long ranged physical damage by additional 4%.
6 pieces : CRI + 15, increases critical damage by 35%, every 3 enhancement rate, increases critical damage by additional 5%.
4000000008.description_k:
2개 : 근접/원거리 물리 데미지 6% 증가. 3강화 당, 근접/원거리 물리 데미지 1%씩 추가 증가.
4개 : P.ATK + 20, 근접/원거리 물리 데미지 4% 추가 증가.
6개 : CRI + 15, 크리티컬 데미지 35% 증가. 3강화 당, 크리티컬 데미지 5%씩 추가 증가.
